name: Rice (Paddy)
maharashtraRegion: Konkan (Ratnagiri, Sindhudurg, Raigad, Thane), Eastern Vidarbha (Bhandara, Gondia, Chandrapur, Gadchiroli)
description: Primary staple cereal of coastal Maharashtra and Vidarbha lake districts. Grown under puddled flooded conditions or upland terraces.
waterRequirement: 1,000 - 1,400 mm; standing water layer (2-5 cm) during vegetative phase.
soilPreference: Heavy clay loam or silty clay soils with high water retention, pH 5.5 - 7.0.

growthStages.description: Raised bed seedling raising; 21-day seedlings transplanted to puddled field.
Active tiller production and crown root expansion in flooded mud.
Flag leaf emergence and panicle formation inside sheath; flowering begins.
Milky, dough, and mature golden grain hardening; field drained 10 days prior to sickle harvest.

commonDiseases.name: Rice Blast (Magnaporthe oryzae)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Spindle-shaped diamond spots with grey center and dark brown margin on leaves and panicle neck.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Night temperatures 20-24°C with continuous drizzling rain and relative humidity >90%.

commonDiseases.name: Bacterial Leaf Blight (Xanthomonas oryzae)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Water-soaked wavy lesions starting at leaf margins turning dull yellow with white bacterial crusts.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Warm temperatures (25-34°C) with strong wind-driven monsoon rains.

commonDiseases.name: Sheath Blight (Rhizoctonia solani)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Greenish-grey oval water-soaked blotches on leaf sheaths just above the waterline.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: High humidity (>95%) and heavy top-dressed nitrogen fertilizer.

generalPrevention: Use certified resistant varieties such as Karjat-3, Indrayani, PKV HMT, or Ratna.
Treat seed with Trichoderma harzianum @ 5g/kg or Carbendazim @ 2g/kg.
Adopt Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD) water management to suppress Brown Planthopper.
Avoid excessive basal urea; split nitrogen into 3 equal applications with potassium at panicle stage.

name: Wheat
maharashtraRegion: Western Maharashtra (Pune, Ahmednagar, Satara, Kolhapur), Vidarbha (Nagpur, Amravati), Khandesh (Jalgaon)
description: Premier winter cereal crop of India, grown extensively under irrigated black cotton soils in Maharashtra and alluvial plains of North India.
optimalTemp: 12°C - 25°C (cool nights during tillering, bright sunshine during grain fill)
waterRequirement: 400 - 500 mm across 4-6 critical irrigations (CRI, tillering, jointing, flowering, milking).
soilPreference: Deep, fertile well-drained clay loam or medium black cotton soil, pH 6.5 - 7.5.

growthStages.description: First whorl of crown roots forms below soil surface; paramount irrigation window.
Nodes elongate, vegetative tillers develop; canopy closes.
Earhead emerges from flag leaf boot; pollination occurs.
Starch accumulates; straw turns golden yellow; grains harden.

commonDiseases.name: Brown / Leaf Rust (Puccinia triticina)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Round to oval orange-brown powdery pustules scattered randomly across upper leaf blade.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Warm humid winter days (18-25°C) with morning dew.

commonDiseases.name: Yellow / Stripe Rust (Puccinia striiformis)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Linear bright yellow stripes of powdery pustules arranged between leaf veins.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Cool winter temperatures (10-18°C) with persistent fog.

commonDiseases.name: Loose Smut (Ustilago tritici)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Entire earhead transformed into a loose sooty black mass of fungal spores.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Infected seeds germinating in cool moist soil.

generalPrevention: Sow in first fortnight of November to escape terminal heat in Central India.
Use certified high-yielding resistant varieties: Samadhan (NIAW-1994), Trimbak, or MACS-6222.
Treat seed with Carboxin + Thiram (Vitavax) @ 2.5g/kg for complete loose smut control.
Irrigate lightly at milk stage on calm windless days to prevent crop lodging.

name: Sorghum (Jowar)
maharashtraRegion: Solapur (Maldandi Capital of India), Marathwada (Latur, Beed, Osmanabad), Ahmednagar, Pune, Jalgaon
description: The golden heart of Maharashtra dryland agriculture. Drought-resilient C4 cereal famous for delicious pearl bhakri and high-quality livestock fodder (kadbi). Solapur Maldandi M 35-1 is world-renowned.
soilPreference: Medium to deep black clay soils (Vertisols) with moisture retention, pH 6.5 - 8.5.

growthStages.description: Rapid germination; shoot fly vulnerable period.
Dense node elongation; growing point converts into panicle.
Spike emerges from flag leaf collar; cross-pollination by wind.
Pearly grains fill; black layer at seed base marks physiological maturity.

commonDiseases.name: Grain Mold (Fusarium & Curvularia)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Pink, black, or grey discoloration on developing grain heads following rain.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Unseasonal wet spells during grain-filling stage.

commonDiseases.name: Downy Mildew (Peronosclerospora sorghi)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Vivid chlorotic yellow striping on leaves with downy white fungal growth on undersides.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: High humidity with cool night temperatures (20°C).

commonDiseases.name: Charcoal Rot (Macrophomina phaseolina)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Internal stalk shredding with tiny charcoal-like sclerotia causing lodging.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Post-flowering soil moisture stress and soil temperatures exceeding 35°C.

generalPrevention: Complete sowing within 10-15 days of monsoon onset to escape destructive shoot fly egg laying.
Treat seed with Imidacloprid 70 WS @ 7g/kg + Trichoderma @ 4g/kg.
Adopt famous resistant cultivars like Phule Yashoda, Maldandi M 35-1, or Parbhani Moti.
Intercrop with Pigeon pea (Tur) in a 2:1 ratio to interrupt stem borer life cycles.

name: Pearl Millet (Bajra)
maharashtraRegion: Ahmednagar, Nashik, Dhule, Jalgaon, Beed, Aurangabad, Pune rain-shadow belts
description: Climate-smart super-millet loaded with iron, zinc, and fiber. Thrives on light shallow soils under erratic rain-shadow monsoon belts.
soilPreference: Well-drained sandy loam, gravelly or shallow black soils, pH 6.0 - 8.0.

growthStages.description: Rapid crown tillering in dry soil conditions.
Cylindrical bristled spike developing inside sheath.
White feathery stigmas emerge first followed by yellow anthers; wind-pollinated.
Dense greyish-pearl grains harden; ready for harvesting.

commonDiseases.name: Downy Mildew / Green Ear (Sclerospora graminicola)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Floral spikes transform into twisted leafy green brush structures; chlorotic leaf stripes.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Humid overcast days with temperatures around 20-25°C.

commonDiseases.name: Ergot (Claviceps fusiformis)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Pinkish sticky honey-like liquid oozes from spikelets, later hardening into dark sclerotia.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Rainy, overcast days during protogynous flowering.

commonDiseases.name: Rust (Puccinia substriata)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Reddish-brown powdery pustules on both leaf surfaces causing premature drying.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Warm humid conditions after earhead emergence.

generalPrevention: Treat seed with Metalaxyl (Apron 35 SD) @ 6g/kg to immunize seedlings against downy mildew.
Dip seeds in 10% brine solution; skim off and destroy floating ergot sclerotia.
Plant bio-fortified high-yielding hybrids such as Dhanshakti, Phule Aadishakti, or GHB-538.

name: Maize (Corn)
maharashtraRegion: Khandesh (Jalgaon, Dhule), Nashik, Aurangabad, Kolhapur, Sangli
description: High-yielding versatile cereal cultivated for grain, poultry feed, green fodder, and industrial starch. Has seen massive expansion in Khandesh and Marathwada.
waterRequirement: 500 - 650 mm; critical water demand during tasseling and silking.
soilPreference: Deep, fertile, well-aerated sandy loam to clay loam rich in organic matter, pH 6.0 - 7.5.

growthStages.description: Crown roots anchor; whorl leaves unfold rapidly.
Terminal tassel emerges shedding millions of airborne pollen grains.
Sticky silky strands emerge from ear shoot to capture falling pollen.
Kernels fill with starch; black layer forms at grain base at maturity.

commonDiseases.name: Maydis Leaf Blight (Bipolaris maydis)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Elongated tan lesions with brown borders on leaf blades.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Warm, humid conditions (20-30°C) with intermittent rain.

commonDiseases.name: Turcicum Leaf Blight (Exserohilum turcicum)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Long, elliptical grayish-green cigar-shaped necrotic lesions on foliage.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Cool, wet weather with heavy dews.

commonDiseases.name: Common Rust (Puccinia sorghi)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Golden-brown powdery pustules covering both leaf surfaces.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Cool, humid weather (16-23°C).

generalPrevention: Install pheromone traps @ 10/ha to detect Fall Armyworm moths immediately upon emergence.
Apply neem-based Azadirachtin 1500 ppm or Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) @ 2g/L into leaf whorls.
Ensure ridge-and-furrow planting to prevent root waterlogging.

name: Finger Millet (Ragi / Nachani)
maharashtraRegion: Konkan (Thane, Palghar, Raigad, Ratnagiri), Western Ghat hilly tribal belts of Nashik and Kolhapur
description: Ancient climate-resilient superfood millet celebrated for extraordinary calcium and amino acid content. Staple grain of Konkan tribal farmers and nutritious bhakri.
waterRequirement: 400 - 600 mm; tolerates high rainfall on sloped hill terrains without lodging.
soilPreference: Red sandy loam, gravelly laterite, or shallow hill soils, pH 5.0 - 7.5.

growthStages.description: Tiny seeds raised on raised beds; transplanted to hill slopes.
Dense fibrous root system establishes in rocky hillside soil.
Digit-like whorl of 4 to 8 spicate fingers unfolds.
Seeds turn dark brown/russet; cut with sickle at full maturity.

commonDiseases.name: Ragi Blast (Pyricularia grisea)
commonDiseases.symptoms: Spindle-shaped lesions on leaf; choking black lesions on neck and fingers causing severe yield loss.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Cloudy, humid weather in Western Ghat hills during monsoon.

commonDiseases.name: Foot Rot / Wilt (Sclerotium rolfsii)
commonDiseases.symptoms: White mycelial fan at collar region with mustard-seed-like sclerotia.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Warm soil with moisture stagnation.

generalPrevention: Use blast-tolerant university varieties like Phule Nachani, Dapoli-1, or GPU-28.
Treat seed with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10g/kg prior to nursery sowing.

name: Foxtail Millet
description: Fast-maturing, drought-tolerant nutrient-rich ancient millet with low glycemic index. Used for wholesome porridge, upma, and flour.
soilPreference: Light sandy loam to shallow black soils, well-draining.

growthStages.description: Yellowish cylindrical drooping bristly spikes bloom.

commonDiseases.name: Blast
commonDiseases.symptoms: Brown circular spots on leaves and panicles.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Overcast skies and sustained humidity.

generalPrevention: Seed treatment with Thiram @ 3g/kg.

name: Barnyard Millet (Bhagar / Varai)
maharashtraRegion: Nashik (Trimbak), Konkan, tribal belt of Pune and Ahmednagar hills
description: Fastest-growing grain crop on earth (matures in 60 days). The revered staple grain for fasting (Upwas Bhagar) across Maharashtra.
waterRequirement: 300 - 450 mm; withstands severe drought as well as seasonal waterlogging.
soilPreference: Marginal, gravelly hill slopes and poor shallow soils, pH 5.5 - 7.5.

commonDiseases.name: Smut
commonDiseases.symptoms: Ovaries swollen into gall-like masses.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Cool, wet mornings.

generalPrevention: Seed treatment with bio-agent Trichoderma viride.

name: Little Millet
maharashtraRegion: Tribal areas of Nandurbar, Gadchiroli, Chandrapur, Thane
description: Nutritious minor millet that grows on impoverished soils where almost no other cereal can yield.
soilPreference: Shallow gravelly red or lateritic soils.

commonDiseases.name: Rust
commonDiseases.symptoms: Small orange spots.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Post-monsoon humidity.

generalPrevention: Sow with first soaking monsoon rains.

name: Kodo Millet
maharashtraRegion: Konkan hills, Vidarbha forest belts, Satpura ranges
description: Extremely hardy ancient millet rich in polyphenols and dietary fiber, cultivated since Indus Valley times.
soilPreference: Poor stony soils with minimal nutrition.

commonDiseases.name: Head Smut
commonDiseases.symptoms: Dark powdery grains.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: High rainfall.

generalPrevention: Use certified seed.

name: Proso Millet
description: Matures in only 60 to 75 days with lowest water requirement of any cereal grain.

commonDiseases.name: Leaf Smut
commonDiseases.symptoms: Sooty streaks on leaf.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Warm damp spells.

generalPrevention: Timely harvesting to prevent lodging.

name: Barley
description: Cool-season cereal used for nutritious sattu flour, malt, beverage production, and animal feed. Highly salt-tolerant.
soilPreference: Sandy to clay loam, tolerates salinity.

commonDiseases.name: Covered Smut
commonDiseases.symptoms: Persistent membrane enclosing black spore mass.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Seed infection.

generalPrevention: Seed treatment with Vitavax @ 2.5g/kg.

name: Oats
maharashtraRegion: Pune, Nashik, Satara dairy tracts (high fodder value)
description: Premium breakfast cereal and succulent dairy green fodder rich in beta-glucan and minerals.

growthStages.description: Grain filling for milling or forage cut.

commonDiseases.name: Crown Rust
commonDiseases.symptoms: Orange pustules on upper leaves.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Mild humid winter.

generalPrevention: Cut early at 50% flowering for highest protein fodder.

name: Basmati Rice
maharashtraRegion: Punjab, Haryana, Western UP, Tarai belt of India
description: The world-famous long-grain aromatic rice protected under Geographical Indication.

growthStages.description: Fragrant panicles with long slender spikelets.

commonDiseases.name: Bacterial Blight
commonDiseases.symptoms: Water-soaked wavy leaf margins.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Heavy rain.

generalPrevention: Pusa Basmati 1121, 1509 varieties.

name: Indrayani Fragrant Rice
maharashtraRegion: Maval (Pune), Kolhapur, Satara, Nashik Western Ghats
description: Renowned fragrant, sticky medium-slender rice created by MPKV Rahuri, the heart of Maharashtrian cuisine.

growthStages.description: Harvest when 85% grains turn straw golden.

commonDiseases.name: Blast
commonDiseases.symptoms: Diamond lesions.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Overcast monsoon weeks.

generalPrevention: Adopt certified breeder seeds from MPKV.

name: Ambemohar Traditional Rice
maharashtraRegion: Bhor, Mulshi, Velhe, Maval foothills of Pune district
description: Traditional GI-tagged scented short-grain rice with aroma reminiscent of mango blossoms (आंबा मोहोर). Ideal for baby food, khichdi, and kheer.

growthStages.description: Intense mango floral fragrance during morning anthesis.

commonDiseases.name: Leaf Blast
commonDiseases.symptoms: Spindle-shaped lesions.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Cool, misty mountain mornings.

generalPrevention: Maintain pure organic cultivation.

name: Rye
maharashtraRegion: Himalayan foothills and experimental cool zones
description: Cold-hardy grain used for artisan bread, crispbread, and nutrient-dense cover crops.

commonDiseases.name: Ergot
commonDiseases.symptoms: Purple-black sclerotia.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Wet flowering.

generalPrevention: Deep plowing to bury ergot sclerotia.

name: Durum Wheat (Bansi Wheat)
maharashtraRegion: Marathwada, Vidarbha, Western Maharashtra black soils
description: Hard vitreous amber grain with high protein and gluten strength, preferred for semolina (suji/rava), pasta, and daliya.

commonDiseases.name: Stem Rust
commonDiseases.symptoms: Dark brown pustules.
commonDiseases.riskPeriod: Warm winter spells.

generalPrevention: Use MACS-2846, AKDW-2997-16 (Sharada) resistant varieties.
